name: Edgar Markov
description: Edgar Markov is an ancient vampire, Sorin's grandfather, and the ancestor of Innistrad's vampires.

description_citations.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

bio.text: Jace saw visions of Edgar Markov and twelve vampires opening an angel's veins and drinking her silver blood at an altar, perhaps the birth of Innistrad's vampires.

bio.text: Six millennia earlier, Sorin warned him that vampires would drink Innistrad dry, and Edgar dismissed it.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov inflicted vampirism on his grandson Sorin, awakening Sorin's planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: Edgar inflicted his curse of vampirism on his grandson Sorin, awakening Sorin's latent planeswalker's spark .

citation.text: "Helvault", section "Birth of vampirism". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov, urged by the demon Shilgengar, traps and exsanguinates the angel Marycz and creates the ritual of vampirism.
timeline.quote: Markov and his sons trapped the angel Marycz in his laboratory and exsanguinated her

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Birth of Vampirism". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Edgar forces his grandson Sorin to turn, igniting Sorin's planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: the trauma of the transformation caused the boy's planeswalker spark to ignite

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Birth of Vampirism". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia drinks the angel Marycz's blood in Shilgengar's Ritual and becomes an immortal vampire.
timeline.quote: This turned her into an immortal vampire .

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At 16, Sorin is forced to drink the blood of the archangel Marycz in Shilgengar's Ritual, igniting his spark.
timeline.quote: The trauma of the transformation and the situation caused Sorin's planeswalker spark to ignite.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Vampiric Ascension". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov undergoes a blood ritual during a famine, giving birth to vampires on Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Thus were vampires born on Innistrad.

citation.text: "Vampire", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov, an alchemist in Stensia, performs a blood ritual during a famine, creating the first vampires of Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Thousands of years ago, before there were vampires on Innistrad, Edgar Markov was an alchemist in the land that would become Stensia.

citation.text: "Sorin's Homecoming". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The demon Shilgengar encourages Edgar's blood experiment, which Edgar wanted to achieve agelessness for himself and Sorin.
timeline.quote: A demon called Shilgengar preyed on Edgar's ambition and whispered secrets that would point the way toward Edgar's blood-feeding experiment.

citation.text: "Sorin's Homecoming". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Edgar anoints Sorin with the vampiric state and Sorin vanishes, his planeswalker spark ignited by the trauma.
timeline.quote: The trauma of the transformation had caused Sorin's planeswalker spark to ignite.

citation.text: "Sorin's Homecoming". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Most vampires revile Sorin as a traitor for creating Avacyn and he is no longer welcome at Markov Manor.
timeline.quote: Some of the vampires understood Sorin's act, but most reviled him as a traitor.

citation.text: "Sorin's Homecoming". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 9 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov, prodded by the demon Shilgengar, creates vampirism on Innistrad and inflicts it on his grandson Sorin, awakening Sorin's planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: Edgar inflicted his curse of vampirism on his grandson, Sorin, awakening Sorin's latent planeswalker spark.

citation.text: "The Prison of Silver". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Jan 2012. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jace enters the manor's archway, carved with monsters and a giant vampire.
timeline.quote: He stepped into the archway and the stone walls enfolded him.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace experiences the dead man's memory of vampires grabbing him, with Edgar Markov approaching.
timeline.quote: I step back and suddenly there are hands all around me, clutching at me.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace witnesses a vision of Edgar Markov and twelve vampires opening an angel's veins and drinking her silver blood at an altar, perhaps the birth of Innistrad's vampires.
timeline.quote: The knife slashes and glowing silver blood erupts from the angel's neck.

citation.text: "The Mystery of Markov Manor" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 30 Mar 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia mocks Sorin and orders him thrown out, saying the scion of Edgar Markov is not welcome.
timeline.quote: The scion of Edgar Markov is not welcome here

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: The crew spots a castaway on a seastack and Vraska recognizes Jace Beleren, resolving to petrify him.
timeline.quote: It was Jace Beleren.

citation.text: "The Talented Captain Vraska" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Sep 2017.

timeline.summary: Vraska reports that the crew has lost Edgar.
timeline.quote: We lost Edgar

citation.text: "The Race, Part 1" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Oct 2017.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov creates the curse of vampirism on Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Edgar Markov creates the curse of vampirism on Innistrad with the assistance of the demon Shilgengar

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Time of Legends (-5000 AR to 0 AR) [ 17 ] [ 10 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia Voldaren disturbs the Dawnhart ritual, begins the Eternal Night, captures Sigarda and plans to marry Edgar Markov to control the bloodlines.
timeline.quote: Olivia sought to take control over the vampiric bloodlines by marrying the charmed Edgar Markov

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Reign of Olivia Voldaren". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin's attack on Olivia awakens Katilda's spirit from the Key, which frees the captive Sigarda.
timeline.quote: used her powers to free Sigarda

citation.text: "Moonsilver Key", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In a flashback to six millennia earlier, Sorin tells his grandfather Edgar that vampires will drink Innistrad dry and Edgar dismisses it.
timeline.quote: "Sorin. Do you truly believe I've never had the same thought?"

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin goes into the family archives to wake his grandfather Edgar and ask for a plan.
timeline.quote: His grandfather had been slumbering for long enough.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin discovers that Edgar's mausoleum and coffin have been stolen.
timeline.quote: the coffin itself is missing

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals the invitation to Olivia Voldaren's wedding and that she has stolen Edgar; if they marry she will rule all of Innistrad.
timeline.quote: "She's stolen my grandfather.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Tithes and Invitations" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 28 Oct 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin walks through the estate escorted by guards and reflects that Olivia chose a political marriage with his grandfather.
timeline.quote: It was only natural that someone so nakedly ambitious would hit on the idea of a political marriage.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin is announced in the ballroom and sees his grandfather's coffin on the dais.
timeline.quote: There's no mistaking it: that is his grandfather's coffin.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia cuts her arm to let her blood drip into Edgar's coffin to wake him.
timeline.quote: Old blood, potent blood, blood dark as the night around them, drips onto Edgar Markov's coffin.

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Edgar Markov wakes, drinks Olivia's blood and is presented as her betrothed; he dismisses Sorin's warnings.
timeline.quote: "I present to you my handsome, perfect betrothed: Lord Edgar Markov."

citation.work: Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries
citation.text: "Episode 2: The Dolorous Weight of Pleasantries" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin, chained, studies Olivia's stained-glass window and reflects that her life has marched toward this moment of seized power.
timeline.quote: The larger picture of Olivia's life has always marched toward this.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Olivia welcomes the guests and promises a present for Edgar before the wedding.
timeline.quote: I have a little something else planned first.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: A cage draped in red descends from the ceiling, and Sorin recalls being forced by his grandfather to drink angel blood.
timeline.quote: a familiar scent comes to him—angel blood.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin works out that Olivia plans to control angels by drinking Sigarda's blood bound with the Moonsilver Key and Sungold lock.
timeline.quote: Olivia Voldaren with control over all the angels in Innistrad.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: The false priest begins the ceremony, and Olivia speaks vows to Edgar that mock him.
timeline.quote: And I promise to grant you the honor of being my husband.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin shoves his grandfather aside and fights Olivia to buy the spirit time, and a verdant bolt frees Sigarda.
timeline.quote: he dashes between her and the key, meeting her head-on charge with a wild slash.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sigarda rises freed, declares all of them guilty and shatters the hall with holy light.
timeline.quote: "All of you are guilty," speaks the angel.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Forever Hold Your Peace" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin follows his grandfather into the sanguitorium and urges him to see Olivia is only using him.
timeline.quote: "Grandfather, you know this is foolish. She's only using you."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Edgar breaks Sorin's wrist and throws him into a vat, accusing him of never being part of the family.
timeline.quote: Edgar catches Sorin's wrist, his fingers a vise.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin batters Edgar with an iron pipe, but Edgar insists he created Avacyn from his research and has squandered his gift.
timeline.quote: "Your little toy soldier? Yes, I'm aware."

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Edgar slams Sorin into a vat and he relives being forced to drink angel's blood at the family gathering.
timeline.quote: Memory subsumes reality.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Edgar throws Sorin into a great pit.
timeline.quote: And Sorin Markov continues to fall.

citation.text: "Episode 4: The Wedding Crashers" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Tovolar and the pack arrive to help; Olivia drops the Key and flees with Edgar.
timeline.quote: Olivia dropped the Moonsilver Key and left with Edgar through one of the broken windows, barely escaping from the jaws of Tovolar.

citation.text: "Arlinn Kord", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Shilgengar convinces Edgar to experiment with blood; Edgar traps and drains the angel Marycz, creating the first vampires.
timeline.quote: Markov and his sons trapped the angel Marycz in his laboratory and exsanguinated her

citation.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Edgar forces Sorin to turn and Sorin's spark ignites.
timeline.quote: the trauma of the transformation caused Sorin 's planeswalker spark to ignite

citation.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia steals Edgar's coffin, wakes him and proposes; he agrees.
timeline.quote: The confused Edgar agreed to her marriage proposal.

citation.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Edgar and Sorin fight in the sanguitorium.
timeline.quote: the two came to blows as they hurled insults

citation.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Empowered Sorin overpowers Edgar and shows mercy, ordering him to leave.
timeline.quote: Sorin showed mercy and ordered his grandfather to leave.

citation.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arlinn and her pack find Olivia and Edgar, who escape through a broken window.
timeline.quote: Olivia dropped the Moonsilver Key in defeat and escaped with Edgar

citation.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia leaves for Thunder Junction and Edgar hides in Havengul awaiting his chance.
timeline.quote: awaiting his next chance to return to power

citation.text: "Edgar Markov", section "Recovering power". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia charms Edgar with her blood so he agrees to marry her, planning to control Innistrad's angels with Sigarda's blood.
timeline.quote: Olivia used her blood to wake Edgar from his sleep and, in doing so, managed to charm him.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin attacks during the wedding; Katilda frees Sigarda, whose outburst shatters the glass and wounds guests.
timeline.quote: Katilda used her powers to free Sigarda from her prison.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key in defeat and escapes with Edgar.
timeline.quote: Olivia dropped the Moonsilver Key in defeat and escaped with Edgar through one of the broken windows.

citation.text: "Olivia Voldaren", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin infiltrates Olivia and Edgar's wedding but is overwhelmed by guards and dragged away.
timeline.quote: he was forced to enter on his own

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Katilda frees Sigarda, whose fury shatters the wedding hall.
timeline.quote: Katilda used her powers to free the angel Sigarda from her prison.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin defeats Edgar and shows him mercy.
timeline.quote: Rather than killing Edgar, Sorin showed mercy and ordered him to leave.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Arlinn accepts Tovolar's help tracking Olivia though nothing has changed between them; they find Olivia with Edgar Markov.
timeline.quote: Arlinn accepted his help to track down Olivia

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Olivia drops the Moonsilver Key and flees with Edgar through a window; Arlinn and Tovolar part ways unresolved.
timeline.quote: Olivia dropped the Moonsilver Key and fled with Edgar through one of the windows

citation.text: "Tovolar", section "Crimson Vow". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin, lying in a pit of blood, reflects on Nahiri and Avacyn and his grandfather's betrayal, then drinks the blood to heal.
timeline.quote: They thought this cellar would drown him, but it's only made him stronger.

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin cuts through the guards and duels his grandfather Edgar, defeating him.
timeline.quote: In the end, it is Edgar who falls from the rumble first

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.

timeline.summary: Sorin spares Edgar's life and tells him to get out of his sight; Edgar flees.
timeline.quote: Sorin scowls. "Go. Get out of my sight."

citation.work: Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part
citation.text: "Episode 5: Till Death Do Us Part" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Nov 2021.
